records.boundary_of_proof: Establishes which CVEs CISA listed as known-exploited at retrieval time. Absence from the catalogue is not proof that a vulnerability does not exist or cannot be exploited.
records.reuse_status: official catalogue; preserve attribution and review linked terms before redistribution

records.boundary_of_proof: Establishes what NVD published for the requested CVE at retrieval time. Does not show that any customer runs an affected product; NVD records are revised after the fact.
records.reuse_status: review current NVD terms and referenced third-party material; cache responses with retrieval time
